definitions.explanation: Working together in agreement with others.
Finding common ground between different parties.

notes:
{協調|きょうちょう} emphasizes working together harmoniously.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {協調|きょうちょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cooperate, to coordinate)
- {協調|きょうちょう}⟦{性|せい}→〜性：09880_sei⟧ (cooperativeness)
- {協調|きょうちょう}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧ (cooperative approach)

USAGE:
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{協調|きょうちょう} (international cooperation)
- ⟦{労使|ろうし}→労使：27897_roushi⟧{協調|きょうちょう} (labor-management harmony)
- ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧{協調|きょうちょう} (policy coordination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {協調|きょうちょう}: harmony, cooperation (emphasis on agreement)
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation (emphasis on combined effort)
- ⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧: collaboration (working together)
